messages:
Maya Chen: FYI customer reporting invoice #INV-2026-019 is stuck as 'payment_failed' after card attempt and is asking for Net 45 instead of Net 30. They say VAT was charged but their AP needs net45 approval and a proper PO. @Elena Morales can finance review?
Liam O'Connor: opening ticket now, tagging billing ops. Can you paste the error details?
Support Bot: Ticket #SUP-4821 created for INV-2026-019 — assigned to billing-team.
Maya Chen: Customer (Ryan) sent: 'we attempted to pay with corporate card; transaction failed during 3DS. Our AP needs PO to approve Net45; we can provide VAT ID and updated billing address — can you reissue invoice with PO field?'
Liam O'Connor: quick look at payment logs shows decline code from gateway: `3DS_REQUIRED` then `address_verification_failed` on retry. Short repro snippet from logs:```json
{"invoice":"INV-2026-019","gateway_tx":"gw_88a7","status":"card_failed","code":"3DS_REQUIRED","avs":"N"}```
Liam O'Connor: Card declined due to 3DS flow not completed + AVS mismatch. Gateway won't auto-retry for Net terms invoices, that's expected.
Elena Morales: For Net >30 we need an approved PO and a signed net-terms addendum (legal). Net45 is not our default. If customer can provide PO + VAT ID (EU format), we can consider 45-day terms but need manager sign-off.
Samir Patel: I'm AM on the account. Ryan has said finance can produce PO this afternoon but can't complete 3DS flow for the declined card. Their preferred path: either (A) allow Net45 once PO is uploaded, or (B) accept ACH/Bank transfer and mark invoice paid manually so service isn't interrupted.
Ryan G.: Confirming — we can upload PO and our VAT ID (GB999999973). Card issuer refuses 3DS popup for corporate card portal. ACH is fine but takes 3-5 days. We need temporary access for our staging keys.
Liam O'Connor: Proposed workaround: 1) reissue invoice with PO number in 'po_number' field and VAT ID in billing. 2) finance does provisional approval for Net45 pending signed addendum, 3) we allow a one-off temporary credit hold for production keys for 72h.
Elena Morales: I can do provisional approval but need a written commitment + PO scan. I'll escalate to manager for one-off Net45 approval. If PO and VAT ID arrive, mark invoice as 'pending-approval' and schedule manual settlement once payment received.
Maya Chen: Can someone verify whether our billing page can accept PO on an existing invoice or if we must issue a credit and new invoice?
Liam O'Connor: Billing system support: we can append PO to existing invoice metadata and re-send PDF, no need to reissue invoice number. But to change payment terms we either add a 'provisional-terms' tag or issue a new invoice. For speed, do provisional approval in finance and add 'manual-settlement' tag.
Support Bot: Note: attaching file upload link for PO -> https://uploads.example.com/SUP-4821/po_upload
Samir Patel: I'll PM Ryan to get the PO upload and VAT scan. Once uploaded I'll post here.
Ryan G.: Uploaded PO (PO-99321) and VAT scan to the link. Also included preferred bank details for ACH.
Liam O'Connor: Received. I updated invoice metadata: added PO-99321, VAT: GB999999973, billing_address: "42 Dock St, London, UK, SE1 2AA". Resent invoice PDF and payment instructions.
Elena Morales: Manager approved provisional Net45 for this customer for 72h to avoid service disruption. Conditions: PO must be valid, VAT ID verified, and Finance will reconcile once ACH clears. If ACH not received within 5 business days, terms revert and access will be suspended.
Maya Chen: What's left for support to do?
Liam O'Connor: Track ACH incoming; if they opt for ACH, mark invoice paid on receipt. If they still want to retry card, advise on AVS and that 3DS must be completed in issuer flow (cardholder browser). Send these repro steps to customer:```
1) Try payment from a personal card that supports 3DS or complete issuer 3DS popup in the corporate portal.
2) Ensure billing street, postal code match card billing address to avoid AVS fail.
3) If using gateway retry API: POST /payments/retry {"invoice":"INV-2026-019","method":"card"} with customer present to complete 3DS.```
Elena Morales: I'll mark SUP-4821 with 'provisional_net45' and 'need_reconciliation' tags. Finance will confirm after settlement.
Samir Patel: Ryan, thanks — please confirm once ACH is initiated. We'll remove hold immediately after settlement. :thumbsup:
Ryan G.: ACH initiated today, ETA 3 business days. Appreciate the provisional lift and quick turnaround.
Liam O'Connor: Closing loop: provisional Net45 granted, PO attached, VAT verified, temporary access granted for 72h. Finance follow-up required on receipt. Reopen thread if payment fails or if legal needs signed addendum. :eyes:
